name: Engine Flywheel
description: 280 mm engine flywheel: rimmed disc with a thinned web, hub boss, 30 mm pilot bore and the six-bolt crankshaft flange pattern.

steps.instruction: Create the flywheel disc, 280 mm diameter and 32 mm thick.

transcript.user_prompt: Create a flywheel disc: a cylinder of radius 140 mm and thickness 32 mm, axis along Z, centered in X and Y with its back face on Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the flywheel disc — 280 mm across and 32 mm thick, sitting on the XY plane.

steps.instruction: Add a central hub boss on the front face.

transcript.user_prompt: Add a central hub boss on the front face: a cylinder of radius 45 mm rising from Z=30 to Z=48, overlapping the disc by 2 mm so the boss stands 16 mm proud of the face.
transcript.assistant_message: I added the hub boss — the flywheel is now 48 mm tall at the centre.

steps.instruction: Cut an annular recess to thin the web.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut an annular recess into the front face between radius 50 mm and radius 115 mm, 12 mm deep (from Z=32 down to Z=20), thinning the web while keeping mass in the rim.
transcript.assistant_message: I recessed the web between the hub and the rim by 12 mm — the mass now concentrates in the outer rim.

steps.instruction: Bore the 30 mm pilot hole through the centre.

transcript.user_prompt: Bore the pilot hole: a 15 mm radius hole straight through the hub and disc at the centre.
transcript.assistant_message: I bored the 30 mm pilot hole through the centre for the crankshaft nose.

steps.instruction: Drill six bolt holes on a 64 mm bolt circle.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill six 4.5 mm radius bolt holes through the hub and disc on a 64 mm bolt circle (radius 32 mm), evenly spaced every 60 degrees starting on the +X axis.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the six mounting holes — the pattern matches the crankshaft's flange.

steps.instruction: Chamfer the rim edges by 2 mm.

transcript.user_prompt: Chamfer both circular rim edges of the 280 mm disc (at Z=0 and Z=32) by 2 mm.
transcript.assistant_message: I chamfered both rim edges by 2 mm to finish the flywheel.
